precheck.summary:
Oracle-strength precheck, round 1, merged from five perspective reports. The acceptance suite reads results through the public storyloop_cli.py status and log commands, run in a subprocess, plus the CLI display of the run result. It prepares state through the real code paths (consistency._outcome and run_stops.pause). Fixture failures go through precondition() and are reported as setup errors, not behaviour failures. AC-1, AC-3, AC-4 and AC-6 cover their own branches adequately. AC-3 and AC-4 (rows that must already pass) should pass on the pre-fix code, but no reviewer could run the suite (shell was restricted), so the external RED run must confirm this. Five findings block: one for AC-2 and four for AC-5. Four more are advisory.

Merge decisions:
- The 'raw call record check can never fail' finding was ranked MUST_FIX by correctness and architecture, and ADVISORY by security, tests and oracle-strength. I kept it as MUST_FIX (ORACLE-AC-5-02). AC-5 is a positive row and R4 is a contracted clause; its only assertions (test_ac5_redacted_bounded.py:182, :186) cannot fail because the fixture has no raw-call content.
- The security reviewer's 'no secret in the location field' finding was renumbered ORACLE-AC-5-03.
- The security reviewer's legacy-path redaction finding was renumbered ORACLE-AC-5-04 and kept blocking. R7 requires the legacy stop to show the same summary, and R2/R3 apply to it, so it is a contracted output branch that is never tested.
- No finding was dropped.

Per perspective:
- correctness: fail, three blocking gaps (AC-2 text target/severity, AC-5 whole-summary length, AC-5 raw-call vacuity).
- security: fail, location redaction and legacy-path redaction/length are untested, and the 300-character limit is checked per field.
- architecture: fail, AC-5 length and raw-call gaps and the AC-2 text check; one over-specification advisory.
- tests: fail, AC-5 length and AC-2 text checks block; the raw-call check and the AC-4 stop key set are advisory.
- oracle-

findings.evidence: Lines 169-172 only assertIn each item's message and location in the status, log and run stop text. The JSON side (assert_listed) requires target, 阻塞, message and location. Every stop block starts with '阻塞点：' (stop_report.py render_stop), so a block-wide search for '阻塞' can never fail. AC-2 says '结构化停点与文本均列出相同的阻塞意见摘要'. R2 requires target and severity 阻塞, and R5 requires the same summary on run, status and log.
findings.message: AC-2 does not check that the status, log and run text show the same summary as the JSON. Text that drops target or severity, or prints message and location on unrelated lines, still passes.

required_change.input: Keep the existing AC-2 fixture: two blocking design findings ('Plan skips the legacy stop migration' at plan:main/constraints/0, 'Plan regression list misses log rendering' at plan:main/regression/0) saved through consistency._outcome. Read the stop text blocks from status, log (storyloop_cli.py without --json) and the run display().
required_change.assertion: In each stop block, drop the '阻塞点：' header line. For each finding, find its rendered entry (the line or lines containing its message) and check that the entry also contains 'design', '阻塞' and its location. Count exactly two such entries per surface.
required_change.expected: On all three surfaces, each of the two findings appears once with target design, severity 阻塞, its message and its location. This fails on pre-fix code and on any renderer that leaves out target or severity.

findings.trigger: An implementation prints only message and location in the terminal text, or prints it differently in log than in status.
findings.impact: The form_parity row passes while the text views differ from the structured summary that R2 and R5 require.
findings.fix: Check the full per-finding summary in each text block, excluding the header line.

findings.evidence: Lines 183-184 assert len(value)<=300 for each value in strings_of(item), so the limit is per field. The text checks only reject 'L'*301 and 'Q'*301 runs. The fixture message is about 955 characters and the location about 510, so truncating each field to 300 gives a summary of about 600 characters that passes. R3 says '将每条新增展示摘要限制在 300 字符以内'.
findings.message: AC-5 checks the 300-character limit per field instead of per whole summary, and never measures the rendered summary line in the text output.

required_change.input: Keep the existing AC-5 fixture: credential text plus a 900×'L' message at plan:main/constraints/0, and a userinfo-URL message at 'plan:main/'+500×'Q'. Read through the run result, status --json, log --json, and the status, log and run text.
required_change.assertion: For each stop.review_findings item, measure len(item) if it is a string, or sum(len(s) for s in strings_of(item)) if it is a dict. In each stop text block, measure every line that carries a finding fragment ('Leaked token=[REDACTED] or 'example.com/repo.git'), after removing the leading indent and list marker.
required_change.expected: Every structured summary totals 300 characters or fewer, and every rendered finding line is 300 characters or fewer, on run, status and log.

findings.trigger: An implementation truncates message and location separately to 300 characters each.
findings.impact: Summaries of about 600 characters pass, so R3 is not enforced.
findings.fix: Assert the length of the whole summary and of each rendered finding line.

findings.evidence: Line 182 (RAW_CALL_KEYS against top-level keys) and line 186 ('.storyloop/calls' absent) assert that something is absent, but the fixture (finding() and consistency_state) holds only target, criterion_id, location, blocking and message. It has no call folder, ledger, call or evidence data. Both assertions pass for any implementation, including one that copies whole stored dicts. AC-5 says '不含…原始调用记录' and R4 says '从新增意见摘要中排除原始代理调用记录'.
findings.message: The check that summaries exclude raw call records can never fail, because the fixture contains no raw call content.

required_change.input: In the AC-5 fixture, add to one blocking design finding the keys 'call':'CALL-raw-01' and 'evidence':'see .storyloop/calls/CALL-raw-01/response.json stdout RAWCALL-MARKER'. Also add a record-level 'transcript':'RAWCALL-MARKER request/response' to planning.consistency. Prepare the stop through the same _outcome path.
required_change.assertion: Serialize each stop.review_findings list (run, status, log), check nested keys against RAW_CALL_KEYS, and search the serialized JSON and each stop text block.
required_change.expected: No RAW_CALL_KEYS key appears at any depth. 'RAWCALL-MARKER', 'CALL-raw-01' and '.storyloop/calls' appear in no review_findings and no stop text, while the two redacted blocking summaries are still listed.

findings.trigger: An implementation copies stored finding dicts, evidence or call data into stop.review_findings.
findings.impact: The R4 ban on raw call records is not verified.
findings.fix: Seed raw call content with a unique marker so the exclusion assertions can fail.

findings.evidence: Lines 151-155: every credential sits in a message. The locations are 'plan:main/constraints/0' and 'plan:main/'+'Q'*500, and neither holds a secret. R2 requires message and location to be shown after redact(). The AC-5 method steps list long locations, and AC-5 requires every summary to be redacted.
findings.message: No location value carries a credential, so an implementation that runs redact() on the message alone passes AC-5.

required_change.input: Add a blocking design finding whose location is 'plan:main/constraints/1 api_key=[REDACTED] https://[REDACTED]@example.com/x' and whose message is a short plain message.
required_change.assertion: Search the JSON review_findings and the stop text from run, status and log.
required_change.expected: 'LocSecretKey77' and 'LocUrlPw88' never appear. That finding's summary contains 'api_key=[REDACTED] and 'https://[REDACTED]@example.com/x'.

findings.trigger: An implementation redacts only the message and copies the location verbatim.
findings.impact: A credential in a location leaks into stop output without detection.
findings.fix: Put credential-shaped text in a location and assert it is redacted.

findings.evidence: In test_ac6_legacy_stop.py:108-111 the saved findings are plain short messages. test_ac5 reaches only the new-stop path through consistency._outcome. stop_of (stop_report.py around 290-313) is a separate display path for legacy stops. R7 requires legacy stops to show '同样的阻塞意见摘要', so R2 (redacted) and R3 (at most 300 characters) apply there too. The branch where the legacy stop is redacted and bounded is never exercised.
findings.message: The legacy-stop branch, where findings are rebuilt from the saved planning.consistency, is never checked for redaction or length.

required_change.input: A legacy run file (stop without review_findings, written as in test_ac6 legacy_run) whose saved blocking design findings have the message 'Leaked token=[REDACTED] '+'L'*900 and the location 'plan:main/'+'Q'*500, plus a finding whose message is 'Clone https://[REDACTED]@example.com/repo.git'.
required_change.assertion: Check stop.review_findings and the stop text from status and log, with and without --json, then compare the run file bytes before and after.
required_change.expected: 'token=[REDACTED] and 'https://[REDACTED]@example.com' appear and no raw secret appears. Every summary is 300 characters or fewer, and the run file is byte-for-byte unchanged.

findings.trigger: The legacy fallback renders saved findings without the same redaction and truncation as new stops.
findings.impact: Users with stops saved before the fix, the population AC-6 targets, could see secrets that were never redacted.
findings.fix: Add a legacy-stop case with secrets and long content to AC-5, or extend AC-6 with these checks.

findings.evidence: The secrets sit near the start of the strings, far from the 300-character cut. storyloop/processutil.py:40 provides redaction_prefix for the case where truncation happens before redaction.
findings.message: No fixture puts a credential across the 300-character cut, so an implementation that truncates before redacting could leak a partial secret.
findings.required_change: Optionally add the message 'x'*280+' https://[REDACTED]@example.com', and assert that no prefix of 'BoundarySecret9' longer than 3 characters appears.
findings.trigger: An implementation truncates to 300 characters and then calls redact().
findings.impact: A partial password could be shown.
findings.fix: Add a credential that straddles the truncation boundary.

findings.evidence: LONG_LOCATION='Q'*500, yet the expected tuple requires the full 'Clone https://[REDACTED]@example.com/repo.git before merge' in the same item. The contract does not set field order or how the length budget is split.
findings.message: A single-string summary that puts location before message and then truncates would be rejected, which is slight over-specification.
findings.required_change: Optionally match a shorter message prefix, or accept truncation of either field.
findings.trigger: A summary string with location first, truncated to 300 characters.
findings.impact: Implementations must budget the length explicitly; this is easy to satisfy.
findings.fix: Relax the message match to a prefix.

findings.evidence: Selected fields (blocker, options, resume, evidence, facts, questions, attempts) are compared one by one, and a MARKER search covers the rest.
findings.message: AC-4 does not compare the stop's full key set.
findings.required_change: Optionally assert that the stop's key set equals the pre-fix key set.
findings.trigger: New keys are added to other stop statuses.
findings.impact: Minor, because the MARKER check already catches leaked findings.
